points.description: States that a canal fall is provided where the natural (ground) slope of the region/terrain is steeper than, i.e. more than, the canal bed slope being provided (natural ground slope > designed canal slope). The relationship must be stated in the correct direction.
points.partial_credit: Half only if the situation is clearly about ground slope versus canal slope but the direction or comparison is imprecise; otherwise 0.

points.description: Explicitly refers to both quantities with correct terms: the natural/ground slope of the region AND the canal slope (bed slope) being provided, comparing the two, not just saying 'steep land' or 'uneven ground'.
points.partial_credit: Half if only one of the two slopes is named precisely.

rubric.notes: Full marks (2) only if the answer states that natural ground slope is greater than the canal slope provided, naming both slopes. Give part marks only if the comparison is clearly mostly stated (e.g. steep terrain compared with canal slope but loosely worded). Vague answers such as 'to reduce velocity', 'when the land is uneven' or 'to drop water' or a reversed relationship earn 0.
